rule_or_requirement: Preserve completion and reduce median lap time using legal image-only observations, no fixed method requirement.
observable_information: Current and prior images/HUD and own actions only; connected road components and optical flow.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four separate mechanisms: residual decay handoff, geometric early obstacle gap, missing-road heading continuation, straight-path acceleration.
expected_success_endpoint: 12/12 finishes and median below stable matched control, no promotion until exact ZIP and independent registered validation
control: preview_row_repair stable control; frozen dual reference arm
falsifier: No farther path action activation, incorrect component/flow, lost completion, no time gain or invalid action.
